answers.question: 162 Q1 · Must a loop running on a worker machine (WSL, the Mac) stream its session to the control UI in this story, or is a loop on this control machine enough for now? On this machine the loop's drive can push straight into the local relay the UI already reads (a small change, no daemon edit). A loop on a worker has no local relay: its drive would need a new local channel into that machine's mesh daemon, which forwards up its stream (a daemon change, plus the worker restart to land it).

162 Q2 · While a drive runs, how often should `aof work loop` print its status line (e.g. `03/07 — 36 min, 2 subagents active, last activity 5 s ago`)? Today it prints only when a drive starts or ends.
162 Q3 · When the current drive goes quiet, should the UI call it out (e.g. `quiet 14 min` in a warning tone), or show the times only and leave the judgement to you?

162 Q4 · For a session with no live stream (another node, or after it ended), should the card fall back to a transcript view (assistant text, tool calls, subagent activity, what ~/.aof/watch-session.mjs shows) in this story?
